field.label: Enabled
field.help: Enable this tunnel instance after registration and service configuration are complete.

field.label: Name
field.help: Unique descriptive name for this tunnel instance.

field.label: Role
field.help: Egress client and ingress Mesh node registration remain separate.

field.label: TUN interface
field.help: Unused native FreeBSD TUN interface name required by tun-rs, for example tun0. OPNsense may assign a separate descriptive name.

field.label: Cloudflare team name
field.help: Zero Trust team subdomain without .cloudflareaccess.com. Required only for browser-assisted egress client enrollment.

field.label: Manage Mesh return routes
field.help: For an ingress Mesh node, install the configured Device IP return routes through this TUN after it is ready. Enabled by default; disable when routing is managed separately.

field.label: Mesh return route IPv4 CIDR
field.help: Cloudflare Mesh Device IPv4 network returned through this TUN, for example 100.96.0.0/12. Leave empty to omit the IPv4 route. Used only for enabled ingress Mesh nodes.

field.label: Mesh return route IPv6 CIDR
field.help: Cloudflare Mesh Device IPv6 network returned through this TUN, for example 2606:4700:cf1:1000::/64. Leave empty to omit the IPv6 route. Used only for enabled ingress Mesh nodes.
